prompt: Which benefits does version control actually provide? Choose all that apply.
explanation: Version control gives recoverable history, precise diffs, and safe parallel work. It says nothing about code correctness — that is what review, tests, and CI are for — and it documents changes, not the product itself.

options.text: Restoring any earlier version of a file
Comparing two versions to see exactly what changed
Letting several people work in parallel and blending their changes
Guaranteeing that merged code is bug-free
